title: CFDE Knowledge Center Public Webinar Series Features The Training Center
bodyHtml: The April CFDE Knowledge Center Public Webinar Series featured Dr. Allissa Dillman of the Training Center (TC). Dr. Dillman presented on "Hackathons with Impact: Data-Driven Projects with CFDE", including how to run hackatons along with a readout from the BioIT World Hackathon. If you couldn't make it, check out the webinar recording on YouTube.
summary: The April CFDE Knowledge Center Public Webinar Series featured Dr. Allissa Dillman of the Training Center (TC).
